title: Exponent rules
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.exp.rules.product: Same base, multiplying: add the exponents.
hints.exp.rules.quotient: Same base, dividing: subtract the exponents, top minus bottom.
hints.exp.rules.power: A power of a power: multiply the exponents.
hints.exp.rules.negative: A negative exponent means one over the positive power: 2⁻³ = 1/2³. Anything (but 0) to the 0 power is 1.
hints.exp.rules: Multiply: add exponents. Divide: subtract. Power of a power: multiply. Negative: one over.

misconceptionMessages.exp.multiplied-exponents: Multiplying powers ADDS the exponents: x³ · x⁴ is 3 x's and 4 x's, 7 x's in all.
misconceptionMessages.exp.divided-exponents: Dividing powers SUBTRACTS the exponents: x⁶ / x² = x⁴ (two x's cancel from six).
misconceptionMessages.exp.quotient-added: For dividing, subtract the exponents (top minus bottom), don't add.
misconceptionMessages.exp.quotient-backwards: Subtract top minus bottom: x² / x⁶ = x²⁻⁶ = x⁻⁴.
misconceptionMessages.exp.power-added: A power of a power MULTIPLIES: (x²)³ = x² · x² · x² = x⁶.
misconceptionMessages.exp.negative-means-negative: A negative exponent doesn't make the number negative: it means one over. 2⁻³ = 1/8.
misconceptionMessages.exp.negative-kept: Moving it to the bottom makes the exponent positive: x⁻⁴ = 1/x⁴.
misconceptionMessages.exp.negative-not-flipped: A negative exponent flips the fraction: (2/3)⁻² = (3/2)² = 9/4.
misconceptionMessages.exp.zero-is-zero: Anything (except 0) to the 0 power is 1, not 0.
misconceptionMessages.exp.zero-is-base: A number to the 0 power is 1: each step down divides by the base, and 7¹ ÷ 7 = 1.

sections.title: Multiplying powers
sections.objective: Multiply powers with the same base: x³ · x⁴ = x⁷.
explain: An exponent counts how many times the base is multiplied: x³ = x · x · x.
Multiplying two powers of x puts all those x's together.
sections.key: Same base, multiplying: add the exponents. x³ · x⁴ = x⁷.

sections.title: Dividing powers
sections.objective: Divide powers with the same base: x⁷ / x³ = x⁴.
explain: Dividing cancels matching factors from the top and bottom.
sections.key: Same base, dividing: subtract the exponents, top minus bottom. x⁷ / x³ = x⁴.

sections.title: A power of a power
sections.objective: Raise a power to a power: (x²)³ = x⁶.
sections.key: A power of a power: multiply the exponents. (x²)³ = x⁶.

sections.title: Zero and negative exponents
explain: Going down the powers of 2, each step divides by 2: 2³ = 8, 2² = 4, 2¹ = 2, 2⁰ = 1, 2⁻¹ = 1/2, 2⁻² = 1/4.
So a zero exponent gives 1, and negative exponents give fractions, never negative numbers.
sections.key: Anything (except 0) to the 0 power is 1. A negative exponent means one over: 2⁻³ = 1/2³ = 1/8.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.key: Multiply: add exponents. Divide: subtract. Power of a power: multiply. Negative: one over. Zero: 1.
